title: US Pentagon fails ninth straight audit despite progress in organizing finances
summary_full: The audits check whether financial statements ​are fairly presented and financial systems ‌and processes are soundThe Pentagon failed a financial audit for the ninth consecutive year, according to an inspector general ⁠report released on Monday – but an official said a majority of its units passed for the first time.The US defense department chief financial officer, Jules Hurst, told ⁠Reuters an independent auditor ⁠found that ​financial statements for 14 of the Pentagon’s 25 standalone reporting entities passed in the 2026 fiscal year, which ended in September, up from ⁠11 the prior year. Those entities account for 56% of the department’s assets – and 86% of its liabilities. Continue reading...
